hypothesis: After source-blind interventions contradict the previously identified separable XOR factorization, a direct non-gradient numerical learner can repair its causal representation by discovering the parameters of an initially unknown thresholded interaction, retain 16 independent revised domains, and transfer to new entities without retraining; a strongest equal-information symbolic solver may tie, invalidating numerical advantage.
disclosure: The repair grammar XOR plus optional nonzero three-bit rectangular interaction, 8x8 observable typed inputs, threshold search range 2..7 and source observation plan are supplied inductive biases. Unknown true thresholds, interaction effect values, and factor values are not supplied to learners. This is model selection and parameter identification within a predetermined class, NOT invention of an unspecified computational primitive.

source.public_features: left typed identity 0..7 and right typed identity 0..7, domain ID and opaque per-world action IDs
source.engineering_family: unknown 3-bit row-factor XOR column-factor XOR (unknown nonzero 3-bit delta iff left>=hidden_t_left AND right>=hidden_t_right); hidden thresholds each in [2,7]; deterministic source-only seeded values
source.negative_family: same fit law plus 1 XOR bit iff both left and right are odd (16/64 unforeseen pair changes)
source.birth_and_sealing: pure inspectable engineering-only generator, not authenticated independent scientific source

intervention_protocol.first15: source-blind 8 anchor interventions at left=0,right=0..7 then 7 at right=0,left=1..7
intervention_protocol.repair8: one contradiction witness (7,7), three binary-search interventions for each hidden threshold using observed residual, and one previously unqueried negative confirmation below both thresholds
intervention_protocol.denied: duplicate, budget-excess, unsupported, reserved/original, held transfer and any source use after scoring
intervention_protocol.equal_information: candidate and strong symbolic share the same intervention identities, order and outcome receipt; passive symbolic receives 23 seeded random legal actions and full source charge

models.NUMERIC_REPAIR: 16 signed int32 base-factor entries plus two inferred thresholds and one inferred three-bit delta per domain; no gradient training; evidence replay and cold state integrity
models.SYMBOLIC_STRONG: independently implemented exhaustive 36-threshold ×8-effect parameter candidates, with bipartite XOR graph equation consistency per candidate, same action/evidence; return only unambiguous predictions
models.SYMBOLIC_PASSIVE: same full-class strong symbolic solver, 23 seeded random actions instead of active interventions; compare correct/abstention at same source budget
models.XOR_ONLY: original fixed separable XOR factor representation from first15 anchor queries; 8 additional paid actions but rejects correction; same evidence budget
models.TRAINED_CONVENTIONAL: not implemented in this development-only feasibility screen; required and fully qualified before separate original scientific first-use

evaluation.primary: source-blind mechanism repair and exact cold retention across all 16 learned domains; no numeric-superiority claim where optimized symbolic ties
evaluation.threshold_development: numerical and equally capable symbolic both predict all 65,536 in-family new-entity effects correctly, confident-wrong=0 and cold predictions identical; all 368 source calls charged; passive/ablations measure intervention impact
negative_controls: offfamily 16,384 scores including expected confident error count and abstentions, no retune
negative controls fit and zero-shot transfer
cold tamper with valid-digest forged weights denied
first source receipt before any score, separate public view from hidden source
evaluation.stop_rule: if active fails its own predeclared target or strong symbolic wins, record FAIL; if active ties strong symbolic, report zero unique weight advantage; if off-family errors, report out-of-class transfer FAIL; no automatic promotion
uncertainties: original held-world replicate and paired CI
